name: Base Party Hostel 18-35 Years Old Only
detail: Best location - right in front of the beach, lots of restaurants around, nearby 7-11, right on the main road but tucked away behind a restaurant so it's not too noisy. Amenities are great especially for the value. Bed is comfy. Hot water working. Restroom is big. There's huge lockers and multiple areas to put and/or fix your bags. Parties / events every night and day. The staff are the best!!! The reps too. Would come back just for them! So sweet, friendly, and fun. 100/10!!

name: Balcony Party Hostel Ao Nang Beachfront Adult Only
detail: The entrance dazzled us with its artwork. Walking up to the accommodation felt like entering an old movie theater, with the sounds of 90s music playing. We encountered staff members with smiles greeting us, who spoke both Thai and English. The room was clean, the air conditioning cool, and the bed soft. Traveling to Ao Nang beach was just across the street, with food easily accessible and coming in and out of the accommodation all night. In the comments, it was mentioned that the music was loud until 1 AM, but compared to the sounds at home, it was nothing. Thank you, Baccone.

name: Ava Sea Krabi Resort
detail: The room is clean with a great view and a perfectly sized swimming pool, providing excellent value for the money spent. The room design is also very good, with a well-planned layout. The bathroom is spacious and the water pressure is very strong, making showering enjoyable. There are many clear TV channels available, and breakfast service is good. What impressed me the most was the attentive service provided by the staff, who treated us like family. I was particularly impressed by the two female staff members at the counter during check-in on September 12, 2023, between 11:00 AM and 12:00 PM, especially the slightly chubby one who was always attentive throughout our two-night stay. Unfortunately, I don't know their names, but they gave excellent suggestions.

name: Pak Up Hostel
detail: This accommodation is very convenient, with easy transportation and pleasant scenery, and parking is also very convenient. Both the rooms and public areas are kept very clean, with complete facilities. The pool is relaxing, and the staff is warm and attentive. Overall, the experience is very satisfactory, offering good value for money, and I highly recommend it.

name: Anana Ecological Resort Krabi
detail: The room is clean, the bed is soft, the water pressure is strong, the staff are lovely, and it's quiet and peaceful. The air is nice. I will definitely stay again next time! 👍💪👍👍👍👍

name: The Brown Hotel Krabi
detail: I was a bit nervous about staying at The Brown Hotel since there weren’t many reviews, but it turned out to be much better than expected. Although there’s no elevator, the rooms were spacious, very clean, and the bathroom was spotless. The staff were friendly and helpful, and overall I was extremely satisfied considering the price.

name: COSI Krabi Ao Nang Beach
detail: Soft bed, comfortable sleep, clean room, clean bathroom, strong water pressure, the room is by the road, sometimes there is the sound of cars passing by, easy to find food, across the hotel there is a 7-11, can walk to the beach.

name: Keereen Resort - Ao Nang Krabi
detail: All the staff maintained meticulous politeness and professionalism from check-in to check-out. I believe this is the service that every guest hopes to receive. The hotel has a beautiful view, and although it is a bit far from the main street of Ao Nang, for Krabi, most sea activities will have tour agencies pick you up at the hotel, so it actually isn't a problem for us. Even if you want to go out for meals or shopping near Ao Nang, whether you rent a motorcycle or choose to take a taxi, I think the hotel's location is very convenient. The comfort brought by the hotel's facilities and services is irreplaceable. Don't miss their breakfast. I will definitely come back if I have the opportunity. Thank you.

name: BlueSotel SMART Krabi Aonang Beach - Adults only
detail: This is my second time here and I really like it. The room has a lovely scent, the view from the upper floors is beautiful, and the service is good. I would like to recommend that the hotel have a coffee machine for breakfast instead of using coffee from a kettle. Many hotels have fresh coffee machines for breakfast. I hope to have fresh coffee for breakfast next time.

name: ibis Styles Krabi Ao Nang
detail: 1. The location is quite good, not on a noisy main street, and the environment is quiet. The hotel offers a free shuttle service to and from Ao Nang Beach, and it takes just a few minutes to get to the pier, making island-hopping very convenient. There are plenty of 7-Eleven stores, restaurants, and massage shops nearby, making dining and shopping convenient. The room's balcony is a practical feature for drying wet swimwear from island excursions. 2. The hardware is standardized under chain management, with two swimming pools and a children's play area, making it very suitable for families with kids. The room is well-equipped with basic amenities, including a refrigerator, safe, and stable air conditioning. There is a 24-hour front desk, convenient parking, and a high level of safety. 3. The breakfast variety is sufficient, with options from Chinese, Western, and Thai cuisines, which can satisfy guests before going out to sea. The staff is friendly and can assist with booking island trips and arranging transportation. 4. The cost-performance ratio is outstanding; compared to other resorts along Ao Nang Beach at the same price point, the rates are friendly and suitable for extended stays. ⚠️ Drawbacks 1. It's not possible to walk directly to the beach; you need to take the hotel's shuttle bus. Walking to the beach takes about 10-12 minutes, and it can be tiring when dragging luggage. 2. Some rooms have limited storage space, with smaller wardrobes and fewer electrical outlets. Toothbrushes and toothpaste are not provided, so it's advisable to bring your own. 3. The building is somewhat aged, and a few rooms may have peeling paint or slight limescale in the bathroom corners. Guests can check the rooms upon check-in; if unsatisfied, they can contact the front desk for a room change.
